grammar.title: Basic Past Reference (Was / Were)
grammar.explanation:
**Was / Were** — *to be* fe’lining oʻtgan zamon shakli (edi / boʻldi):

- **I / He / She / It → was**
- **You / We / They → were**

Namuna: **I was at home yesterday.** — Men kecha uyda edim.
Inkor: **was not (wasn’t) / were not (weren’t)**.

Oʻzbek tilida «edim / eding / edi / edik» shaxsga qarab oʻzgaradi, inglizchada esa faqat IKKI shakl bor: was va were.

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: They + were + at + home.

exercises.prompt: Oʻtgan zamonga oʻtkazing: She is at school.

grammar.title: Prepositions Of Time (At / On / In)
grammar.explanation:
**Qachon** ekanini aytish uchun uchta predlog bor. Qaysi birini tanlash vaqt qanchalik **aniq** ekaniga bogʻliq:

- **at** + **soat**: *at seven o'clock, at nine, at half past two*
- **on** + **kun va sana**: *on Monday, on Friday, on 12 May*
- **in** + **oy, fasl, yil** va **kun qismi**: *in July, in spring, in 2026, in the morning*

Eslab qolishning oson yoʻli — kichikdan katta tomon:
- aniq lahza (soat) → **at**
- bir kun → **on**
- uzun davr (oy, yil) → **in**

Bitta istisno bor: **at night** (tunda), «in the night» emas.

Oʻzbek tilida hammasi bitta «-da» qoʻshimchasi bilan: «soat yetti**da**», «dushanba kun**i**», «iyul**da**». Inglizchada esa uchta predlog yodlanadi.

Misol: *I get up **at** six **in** the morning **on** Monday.*

examples.sentence: I get up at seven o'clock.
The English lesson starts at nine.
examples.translation: Ingliz tili darsi soat toʻqqizda boshlanadi.
Dushanba kuni bizda musiqa darsi bor.

examples.sentence: I read a book in the evening.

rules.note: at seven o'clock, at ten · istisno: at night
on Monday, on Sunday, on 12 May
in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening

exercises.prompt: We go to the park ___ Sunday.
I do my homework ___ the afternoon.
exercises.promptTranslated: Men uy vazifasini tushdan keyin bajaraman.

exercises.explanation: Istisno: at night, in the night emas.

exercises.prompt: The exam is ___ Friday, at ten.
exercises.explanation: Kun → on, soat → at. Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham boʻlishi mumkin.

dialogues.title: Conversation Practice
dialogues.scenario: Kunlar, vaqt va tugʻilgan kunlar haqida gaplashish.

comps.title: Time Builder
comps.passage: Today is Monday. It is eight o'clock in the morning. My birthday is in July. I am twelve years old. My English class is at ten. School finishes at three. On Friday I am free.
comps.passageTranslated: Bugun dushanba. Ertalab soat sakkiz. Mening tugʻilgan kunim iyulda. Men oʻn ikki yoshdaman. Ingliz tili darsim soat oʻnda. Maktab soat uchda tugaydi. Juma kuni men boʻshman.

questions.question: What time is it?
questions.explanation: Matn: It is eight o'clock in the morning.

questions.question: In which month is the birthday?
questions.explanation: Matn: My birthday is in July.

comps.title: Listening: Time and Numbers
comps.passage: Today is Monday. It is nine o'clock in the morning. I have English class at ten. My birthday is in May. I am twelve years old. School finishes at three. On Friday I am free and I play football with friends.
comps.passageTranslated: Bugun dushanba. Ertalab soat toʻqqiz. Soat oʻnda ingliz tili darsim bor. Mening tugʻilgan kunim may oyida. Men oʻn ikki yoshdaman. Maktab soat uchda tugaydi. Juma kuni men boʻshman va doʻstlar bilan futbol oʻynayman.

questions.question: What time is the English class?
questions.explanation: Matn: I have English class at ten.

questions.question: When is the birthday?
questions.explanation: Matn: My birthday is in May.

questions.question: How old is the speaker?
questions.explanation: Matn: I am twelve years old.

comps.title: Numbers and Time
comps.passage: Let's review numbers and time! Today is Monday. It is eight o'clock in the morning. My English class is at ten. My birthday is in June. I am fifteen years old.
comps.passageTranslated: Keling, raqamlar va vaqtni takrorlaymiz! Bugun dushanba. Ertalab soat sakkiz. Ingliz tili darsim soat oʻnda. Mening tugʻilgan kunim iyunda. Men oʻn besh yoshdaman.

questions.question: What time is the English class?
questions.explanation: Matn: My English class is at ten.

questions.question: When is the birthday?
questions.explanation: Matn: My birthday is in June.

comps.title: Sam’s Day
comps.passage: My name is Sam. I am twenty years old. My birthday is in June. I get up at seven o'clock in the morning. School starts at eight. On Monday and Wednesday I have music. On Friday I am free. Yesterday was Sunday. It was a good day. I was at home with my family.
comps.passageTranslated: Mening ismim Sem. Men yigirma yoshdaman. Tugʻilgan kunim iyunda. Men ertalab soat yettida turaman. Maktab soat sakkizda boshlanadi. Dushanba va chorshanba kunlari musiqa darsi bor. Juma kuni men boʻshman. Kecha yakshanba edi. Yaxshi kun edi. Men uyda oilam bilan edim.

questions.question: How old is Sam?
questions.explanation: Matn: I am twenty years old.
